title: NCAA: Calimag, Torculas lead San Beda’s escape of gritty EAC
summary: RC Calimag and Aldous Torculas stepped up as San Beda University escaped a gritty Emilio Aguinaldo College side, 89-86, in NCAA Season 102 men's basketball on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
